title: Chimichurri Steak with Corn and Charred Capsicum Salad
desc: Barbecued rump with a bright, light-on-oil chimichurri, corn on the cob and a charred capsicum and rocket salad.

portions.J: 250 g raw rump (about 190 g cooked), 1 cob of corn, half the salad
portions.P: 150 g raw rump (about 115 g cooked), 1 cob of corn, half the salad

ingredients.name: flat-leaf parsley, a big bunch, finely chopped
ingredients.food: fresh herbs (dill, mint, parsley or chives)

steps.title: Make the chimichurri
steps.text: Mix the parsley, oil, vinegar, crushed garlic, oregano, chilli flakes, salt and 2 tbsp water. It's better after 15 minutes.

steps.title: Steak out
steps.text: Take the steak out to come up to room temperature. Pat dry and season well.

steps.title: Grill the veg
steps.text: Hot barbecue. Grill the corn, turning, until charred in spots, and the capsicum until blistered and soft.

steps.title: Grill the steak
steps.text: Cook the rump on the hottest part, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium rare depending on thickness.

steps.title: Rest and salad
steps.text: Rest the steak 5 minutes. Slice the capsicum and toss with the onion, rocket and a spoon of the chimichurri.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the steak across the grain and spoon chimichurri over the top. Corn and salad on the side.

notes: Rump is lean and full of flavour, but it can be chewy: slice thin and across the grain.
